units.source_text: 髭黑大将打算今夜就把玉鬘迎回自家邸内。

en.t: General Higekuro planned to take Tamakazura back to his own residence that very night.

units.source_text: 但倘预先说出，生怕源氏不许，所以秘而不宣。

en.t: But he feared that Genji would not allow it if he announced it beforehand, so he kept it secret.

units.source_text: 此时说道：“我忽然患了感冒，身体异常不适，因思耑返敝寓，以便安心休养。

en.t: At this point he said, “I have suddenly caught a cold and feel terribly unwell, so I am thinking of returning to my humble home to rest in peace.

units.source_text: 若与尚侍分离，不免心挂两头，故欲相偕同往。”

en.t: If I am separated from the Naishi no Kami, my mind will inevitably be divided, so I would like her to come with me.”

units.source_text: 如此婉言托词，立即和玉鬘一同回家去了。

en.t: With this politely phrased excuse, he immediately went home together with Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 内大臣以为如此太过匆忙，应该行个仪式才是。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior thought this was far too hasty and that a proper ceremony ought to be held.

units.source_text: 又念仅为此事而强行阻难，未免令人不快，便道：“任凭他吧。

en.t: Then, thinking that forcibly opposing him over this alone would surely cause unpleasantness, he said, “Let him do as he likes.

units.source_text: 反正此事非我所能左右。”

en.t: In any case, this is not something I can control.”

units.source_text: 源氏闻之，觉得此事唐突，殊非始料所及，但也不便干预。

en.t: When Genji heard of it, he found the matter abrupt and quite unexpected, but he also could not conveniently interfere.

units.source_text: 玉鬘想起自身像盐灶上的青烟一般“随风飘泊”，自伤命苦。

en.t: Tamakazura thought of herself as being like the blue smoke above a salt kiln, “drifting with the wind,” and grieved over her unhappy fate.

units.source_text: 但髭黑大将仿佛盗取了一个美人来，非常欢喜，心满意足。

en.t: But General Higekuro was overjoyed and fully satisfied, as if he had stolen away a beautiful woman.

units.source_text: 为了冷泉帝访晤玉鬘之事，髭黑大将异常嫉妒。

en.t: Because Emperor Reizei had visited and met with Tamakazura, General Higekuro became extraordinarily jealous.

units.source_text: 玉鬘为此不快，看不起髭黑的人品，从此对他态度冷淡，心绪更加恶劣了。

en.t: This displeased Tamakazura; she looked down on Higekuro’s character, and from then on her manner toward him grew cold while her spirits worsened still further.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王当时言词强硬，后来觉得难于下场。

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo had spoken harshly at the time, but later found it difficult to back down.

units.source_text: 但髭黑大将绝不再访，音信全无。

en.t: But General Higekuro never visited again, and there was no word from him at all.

units.source_text: 他已经如愿以偿，便朝夕侍候着玉鬘。

en.t: Having already obtained what he wanted, he attended Tamakazura morning and evening.
